title: Geometry Vibes X Ball
desc: Geometry Vibes X Ball is a sharp one-button reflex challenge through spinning gears, traps and tight geometry. Hold to rise, release to dive and find the rhythm of each course. Solo, two-player, three-player and four-player modes make it easy to race friends.
howto: Pick your solo or multiplayer mode.
Hold the control to make your ball fly upward.
Release to dive back toward the safe line.
Avoid gears, walls and moving traps without losing rhythm.
Finish the level or outlast your rivals.
tips: Use short taps near gears instead of holding forever.
Learn the release point before the obstacle, not at it.
In multiplayer, protect your line rather than copying rivals.
